description: Defines classes and methods for indexing into image arrays, including ImageIndex and ImageIndexIterator, used for managing texture image layers and levels in graphics rendering.

classes.name: ImageIndex
classes.description: Represents an index into a texture image array, including type, level, layer, and count.

classes.name: ImageIndexIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing ranges of ImageIndex objects across mip levels and layers.

methods.name: ImageIndex
methods.description: Default constructor for ImageIndex.

methods.name: ImageIndex(const ImageIndex &other)
methods.description: Copy constructor for ImageIndex.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for ImageIndex.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the texture type.

methods.name: getLevelIndex
methods.description: Returns the mipmap level index.

methods.name: getLayerIndex
methods.description: Returns the layer index.

methods.name: getLayerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of layers.

methods.name: hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if the index has a specific layer.

methods.name: has3DLayer
methods.description: Checks if the index has a 3D layer.

methods.name: usesTex3D
methods.description: Checks if the texture uses 3D texturing.

methods.name: cubeMapFaceIndex
methods.description: Returns the face index for cube maps.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the ImageIndex is valid.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the texture target, not valid for entire cube map level.

methods.name: getTargetOrFirstCubeFace
methods.description: Returns the target or first cube face.

methods.name: isLayered
methods.description: Checks if the index is layered.

methods.name: isEntireLevelCubeMap
methods.description: Checks if the index represents an entire cube map level.

methods.name: Make2D
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a 2D texture at a specific level.

methods.name: MakeRectangle
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a rectangle texture at a specific level.

methods.name: MakeCubeMapFace
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a cube map face.

methods.name: Make2DArray
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a 2D array texture.

methods.name: Make2DArrayRange
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a range of layers in a 2D array.

methods.name: Make3D
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a 3D texture.

methods.name: MakeFromTarget
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex from a texture target.

methods.name: MakeFromType
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex from a texture type.

methods.name: Make2DMultisample
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a multisample 2D texture.

methods.name: Make2DMultisampleArray
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a multisample 2D array.

methods.name: Make2DMultisampleArrayRange
methods.description: Creates an ImageIndex for a range in a multisample 2D array.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than comparison for ImageIndex.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison for ImageIndex.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison for ImageIndex.

methods.name: getLayerIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over layers for 3D or cube textures.

methods.name: ImageIndexIterator
methods.description: Iterator class for traversing image indices over mip levels and layers.

methods.name: Make2D
methods.description: Creates an iterator for 2D textures over mip levels.

methods.name: MakeRectangle
methods.description: Creates an iterator for rectangle textures.

methods.name: MakeCube
methods.description: Creates an iterator for cube textures.

methods.name: Make3D
methods.description: Creates an iterator for 3D textures.

methods.name: Make2DArray
methods.description: Creates an iterator for 2D array textures.

methods.name: Make2DMultisample
methods.description: Creates an iterator for multisample 2D textures.

methods.name: Make2DMultisampleArray
methods.description: Creates an iterator for multisample 2D array textures.

methods.name: MakeGeneric
methods.description: Creates a generic iterator over specified texture types and ranges.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next ImageIndex in iteration.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current ImageIndex.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more ImageIndices to iterate.

methods.name: maxLayer
methods.description: Returns the maximum layer index for the iterator.

methods.name: TextureTypeToTarget
methods.description: Converts a TextureType and layer index to a TextureTarget.
